name: Notice of Right to Participate in Career and Technical Education
description: Reasonable efforts to inform students and parents of the right to participate in CTE programs and of services for students with disabilities in such programs.
quote: The Superintendent or designee shall ensure that reasonable efforts are made to ensure that all students and parents/guardians are informed of students' rights to participate in career and technical education programs and courses as contemplated in this Policy and that students with disabilities enrolled in such programs are entitled to services under state and federal laws and regulations.
